Sora2.prompt: Cinematic slow dolly in shot in ancient Chinese anime style. A tense two-shot confrontation inside a dilapidated wooden house at night. On the right, Xin Yueying, an 18-year-old Chinese woman in pale green ruqun dress with long flowing black hair, slowly stands up from the ground with calculated determination masked as vulnerability. Her face is half-illuminated by warm flickering candlelight, showing feigned pleading and slight trembling as she speaks her fabricated lie with convincing sincerity. On the left, Shen Qingqi, a 22-year-old pale sickly young man in a worn wooden wheelchair, wearing a dark black traditional robe, watches with suspicious narrowed phoenix eyes. He holds a three-foot green sword with the blade slightly lowered, his expression shifting from cold mockery to contemplative consideration as he listens. The candlelight between them creates dramatic chiaroscuro effect with moving shadows, cold blue ambient light in the background. The camera slowly pushes in over 12 seconds with ease-in-out motion, transitioning from medium close two-shot to closer framing. Power dynamic subtly shifts as her calculated performance begins to work on him. Tense psychological battle, narrative turning point, emotional climax.
